priority: P1 before new raw temperature qualification
trigger: A daily-max event has complete max members but min members are absent or NaN.
observation: The raw helper returns 0.5; the postprocess probability helper rejects due to unrelated min requirements.
consequence: Potentially inconsistent eligibility/denominator across raw event evaluation and complete-product postprocessing. No affected archived target established.
minimal_fix: Separate requested-event validation from full-product EMOS/ECC eligibility; keep independent probability computations and ECC protection.

trigger: First monotone calibration block has value=-0.1 and valid x interval.
observation: validate_feature_bank(calibrated=True) accepts because previous starts at -1 and no 0<=value guard is present.
consequence: Malformed bank fails too late; downstream probability guards can still reject it. No negative probability accepted in actual formal score is established.
minimal_fix: Explicit finite/type/range 0<=value<=1 check independently of monotonicity; use existing input guards for extreme integers.

priority: P1 for expanded multi-member source adapters
status: known gap independently illustrated; not proof of real misalignment
trigger: A source supplies reordered member arrays with corresponding member IDs.
observation: Numerical helper uses positions, so same semantic member paths can change probability 0.5 to 0.0 if upstream canonicalization is missing.
consequence: Equal dimensions alone cannot establish joint temporal member identity.
minimal_fix: Provider-level frozen member-axis lineage, initialization and date-support bindings; canonicalize using verified identities or reject unknown mappings.

trigger: Hypothetical supports [0,1000) and [0,1000] differ only in upper closure.
observation: E is supported vs undetermined for <1000; F feature vectors are identical.
consequence: A repair to that support flag cannot change this fixed predictor through its numerical input. Does not imply both futures require different probabilities.
minimal_fix: Audit real collisions and model-claim errors first; add closure/censoring feature in a new version only if justified; refit in legal roles.

status: design distinction requiring implementation; no executed-branch failure asserted
trigger: TAF version/coverage E tasks are used as primary outcomes for branches that only fetch neighboring METAR.
observation: The public TAF is common/free; neighbor queries do not directly change its coverage/selected version at the same comparison time. All 72 current coverage cases are full.
consequence: 144 resolved construction tasks are not evidence of branch discrimination or paid information value.
minimal_fix: Keep these as zero-cost native-source sanity controls; add branch-sensitive neighbor/coverage facts and field-feature-probability-adoption-loss tracing.
